knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Products are used only on the surfaces they are approved for.
The SDS sets ventilation to control fumes.
An unapproved product can damage a finish, which is hard to reverse.

practicalCriteria: Matches approved products to three appliance surfaces.
Confirms ventilation before a simulated fume-producing product.
Refuses an unapproved product and requests an alternative.
passRule: Products matched, ventilation confirmed, and unapproved product refused. Observed by an assessor.
stopWorkCriteria: Unapproved product used on an appliance surface
